# firefox

Firefox (the default browser, super+return) with palette-colored browser chrome.

`setup.sh` links `user.js` (enables `userChrome.css`) and `chrome/userChrome.css` into the profile named in `installs.ini`; a new machine has no profile until Firefox's first start, so run `./install.sh --setup --only firefox` after it. Restart Firefox to see a new palette.

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`firefox/packages`): `firefox`

**Rendered from the palette** (`theme`):

- `firefox/chrome/userChrome.css.tmpl` → `firefox/chrome/userChrome.css`: `accent`, `bg_desktop`, `bg_hover`, `bg_surface`, `bg_widget`, `border_hairline`, `border_inactive`, `fg_bright`, `fg_secondary`, `fg_text`, `name`, `selection_bg`, `selection_fg`, `slug`

**`setup.sh`** (run by `install.sh --setup`): palette-colored chrome in the profile Firefox uses (idempotent). The profile in use is the first install's Default= in installs.ini (profiles.ini's Default=1 can be a stale one). Its path is per machine, so it is linked here, not by stow. A real user.js/userChrome.css there is moved to <name>.bak.<ts>, never deleted.
